Analyst by training. Operator by habit.

Numbers, pipeline and people, all in one profile.

I’ve spent three years building growth engines for SaaS, tech and manufacturing businesses across North America, EMEA and APAC, with data at the centre. Whether I’m structuring a RevOps pipeline, leading a team of 30+, or testing a go-to-market hypothesis, the aim is the same: measurable commercial results.

I hold an MSc in Marketing Analytics from the University of Southampton, completed with First Division honours and a place on the Dean’s List of Outstanding Achievement, backed by a BCom from Amity University. That mix of strategy and statistics lets me brief a CXO in the morning and build the model in the afternoon.

Off the clock I play team sport, because teamwork and resilience are earned under pressure. I played rugby for the University of Southampton, and football and badminton for Amity University.
